title: CollectionService
summary: Tag system for instances: AddTag/HasTag/GetTagged let you mark objects ('Coin', 'Trap', 'Interactable') and process them as groups — without scanning the hierarchy or keeping manual lists.

methods.name: AddTag
methods.description: Tags the instance. Tags replicate to clients and survive parenting moves.

methods.name: GetTagged
methods.description: Every instance currently carrying the tag.

methods.name: GetInstanceAddedSignal
methods.description: Fires whenever an instance gains the tag (including at game start for pre-existing ones).

methods.name: GetInstanceRemovedSignal
methods.description: Fires when the tag is removed or the instance is destroyed.

details.heading: Replication
details.body: Tags set on the server replicate to clients, so client systems can also react to tags. Tags are not DataStore-serialized — they live on instances.

explanation.whatItIs: Sticky labels for objects. Instead of 'find every part named Coin in this folder', you tag coins once ('Coin') and ask CollectionService for all of them, anytime, anywhere they live.
explanation.whyItExists: Grouping by name/parenting is brittle: renames and reparenting break it. Tags decouple 'what an object IS' from where it sits in the tree.
whenToUse: Systems acting on categories: all traps, all coins, all interactables
Behavior plugins: tag a part 'Kill' in Studio, one script handles all of them
Dynamic membership: tag things at runtime and react via GetInstanceAddedSignal
Replacing long GetDescendants scans with targeted GetTagged calls
whenNotToUse: For one-off single objects — just keep a reference
For data-heavy grouping (tags are labels, not data — pair with Attributes for data)
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Studio/script:  AddTag(part, "Coin")

Later, anywhere:
  GetTagged("Coin")              → every coin, instantly
  GetInstanceAddedSignal("Coin") → fires for new coins too

Tags travel with the instance — reparenting is fine.
```
tips: The canonical pattern: handle existing tagged instances AND connect the added signal (both!)
Studio's Tag Editor plugin makes tagging in-edit painless
Combine tags + attributes: tag marks membership, attributes carry the data
commonMistakes: Only connecting GetInstanceAddedSignal — misses instances tagged BEFORE the script ran
Using tag-like names (renaming parts to 'Coin') instead of real tags
Forgetting tags need consistent spelling — define tag name constants in one module

examples.title: The canonical tag handler
examples.code:
-- Server Script
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local function setupCoin(coin)
    if coin:GetAttribute("Collected") then return end
    coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
        if player and not coin:GetAttribute("Collected") then
            coin:SetAttribute("Collected", true)
            coin.Transparency = 1
            coin.CanCollide = false
            print(player.Name .. " collected a coin")
        end
    end)
end

-- 1) Everything tagged already:
for _, coin in CollectionService:GetTagged("Coin") do
    setupCoin(coin)
end

-- 2) Everything tagged in the future:
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Coin"):Connect(setupCoin)
